verdict.rationale: Unity offers cloud services such as multiplayer, Build Automation and AI Assistant credits, so data region or residency is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose where data is stored. Community comments about the editor 'phoning home' concern telemetry, not residency choice, so they do not count as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
